name: Marshall Aid
source:
Prince Justin's grand chamberlain.
Like the heroine, he's sworn allegiance to his master.
The heroine's enemy on the clock but an amicible drinking buddy off it. Their antagonism is limited to the public sphere only and often train together on their time off.
